---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the skill, tooling, or documentation
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What production problem is not being solved today? Be concrete: which stage, which
artifact, which failure.

## Proposed solution

What should change (new reference, schema field, script, template, eval case, docs page)?

## Which layer does it belong to?

- [ ] creative intent (story, characters, theme)
- [ ] cinematic execution (blocking, camera, light, sound, edit)
- [ ] model adaptation (capabilities, exports, degraded mode)
- [ ] tooling (`scripts/`)
- [ ] schemas / templates
- [ ] evals
- [ ] documentation

## Alternatives considered

## Compatibility impact

Does it change a schema, a gate, or an existing artifact? Can it be additive and optional?

## Can it be tested?

Describe the eval case (or rubric) that would prove it works. Deterministic behaviour should
be testable under `evals/cases/`.

\n
